records.title: [Multisegment spectacles for prevention of myopia progression].
records.zh: 德国视角综述/Meta：DIMS、HALT、CARE 等多区离焦框架镜在12个月可减缓屈光与眼轴进展，部分效应在24个月减弱；HAPD尚无RCT。
records.authors: Wabbels Bettina
records.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The prevalence of myopia is postulated to be rising worldwide, along with the risk of secondary complications, such as maculopathy; however, the evidence for this remains inconclusive, particularly for Europe. The focus is on reducing the increased axial length growth in childhood. To this end, myopia control spectacles (MCS) with peripheral myopic defocus have been developed.
METHODS: Review of randomized controlled trials (RCT, ≥ 12 months) reporting axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent refraction (SER) for the MCS technologies currently available in Germany (July 2026): DIMS, HALT, CARE, HAPD. Only absolute effect sizes were considered.
RESULTS: A meta-analysis (17 studies, n = 6175) confirmed significant effects at 12 months, which in some cases were no longer significant at 24 months. During the first 2 years of treatment RCTs for DIMS, HALT and CARE showed significant reductions in SER progression and axial elongation (0.2-0.5 D/year and 0.1-0.26 mm/year, respectively, versus single vision lenses). The longest evidence exists for DIMS and HALT. No RCT is available for HAPD. Combination treatment with low-dose atropine eye drops showed additive effects.
DISCUSSION: MCSs are an effective option for myopia control without relevant side effects, particularly in younger children, rapid progression or with genetic risk factors. The MCS generally remain an out-of-pocket expense. Regular axial length monitoring is recommended; combination treatment with atropine can be considered in cases of insufficient response.

records.title: The Impact of Common Myopia Interventions on Quality of Life: A Cost-Effectiveness Analysis.
records.zh: 近视干预成本效果分析：户外活动最具优势；在QALY框架下防控框架镜（含HAL等）亦可具成本效果，DALY结论更保守。
records.authors: Hu Haoquan, Chen Minfeng, Zhang Jian, Deng Zihan, Yang Xianling, Huang Yilin, Qu Jia, Mao Xinjie
records.journal: Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)
records.abstract:
PURPOSE: To evaluate the cost-effectiveness of multiple myopia control interventions in managing myopia progression from a quality-of-life perspective.
METHODS: A Markov cohort model simulated myopia progression over 10 years in children starting treatment at 8 years of age. Cost-effectiveness was evaluated using the incremental cost-utility ratio (ICUR) and incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER), measured as cost per quality-adjusted life year (QALY) gained and cost per disability-adjusted life year (DALY) averted, respectively. Deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses assessed model robustness. If an intervention exhibited sensitivity or instability, its cost-effectiveness cannot be determined conclusively within the range of parameter variations.
RESULTS: In the QALY analysis, outdoor activity was strongly dominant (ICUR: CN ￥-2641 [US $-371] per QALY). Highly aspherical lenslet spectacles (HALs) showed the most favourable ICUR among remaining interventions (CN ￥114,809 [US $16,125]). Based on the expected values, all interventions except multifocal soft contact lenses (MSCLs), rigid gas permeable contact lenses (RGPCLs) and orthokeratology (OK) demonstrated cost‑effectiveness. However, the results for bifocal spectacle lenses (BSLs), progressive addition lenses and red‑light therapy exhibited instability. In the DALY analysis, outdoor activity remained dominant (saving CN ￥7953 [US $1117] per DALY averted). The expected value analysis revealed that outdoor activity and BSLs were the only cost-effective interventions. Meanwhile, bifocal and progressive addition spectacles and HALs showed sensitivity.
CONCLUSION: From a QALY perspective, outdoor activity, 0.01% atropine and myopia-control spectacle lenses, excluding contact lenses and those with volatile results, were cost-effective, with outdoor activity being dominant and HALs being the most favourable alternative. Using DALYs, only outdoor activity was stably cost-effective, indicating more conservative conclusions.
records.zhAbs: 从QALY看，户外活动、0.01%阿托品及多数近视防控框架镜具成本效果，户外占优、HAL较优；按DALY则仅户外活动稳定具成本效果。接触镜及结果不稳定的方案被排除在主要结论外。

Using DALYs, only outdoor activity was stably cost-effective, indicating more conservative conclusions.

records.title: Effectiveness of spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) in slowing axial elongation and spherical equivalent refraction progression in myopic and pre-myopic children: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
records.zh: HAL高度非球面微透镜框架镜Meta：对近视儿童可能减缓眼轴与SER进展；对近视前儿童证据弱、质量低，不宜强推用于预防。
records.authors: Song Desheng, Xu Tingting, Liu Shuhan, Zhou Lu, Yao Jiaqi
records.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate the efficacy of highly aspherical lenslet (HAL) spectacle lenses on axial length (AL) elongation and spherical equivalent refraction (SER) progression in myopic and pre-myopic Children.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, CNKI, VIP, and WanFang databases were systematically searched from inception to June 2026. Randomized controlled trials (RCT) and prospective cohort studies comparing HAL lenses with single-vision lenses (SVL) for myopia control or prevention were included. Two investigators independently screened literature, extracted data, and assessed the risk of bias. Meta-analysis was performed using RevMan 5.4 software.
RESULTS: A total of six RCTs and two prospective cohort studies, comprising 717 participants, were included. Meta-analysis showed that compared with SVL, HAL lenses significantly slowed AL elongation (MD = - 0.15 mm, 95% CI: -0.20 to - 0.10, P < 0.001) and SER progression (MD = - 0.28 D, 95% CI: -0.41 to - 0.15, P < 0.001). Subgroup analysis based on baseline refractive status revealed that HAL lenses were effective in both myopic and pre-myopic children. However, the treatment effect was more pronounced in myopic children (AL: MD = - 0.17 mm; SER: MD = - 0.33 D) than in pre-myopic children (AL: MD = - 0.09 mm; SER: MD = - 0.13 D).
CONCLUSION: Current evidence suggests that HAL spectacle lenses may slow axial elongation and SER progression in myopic children. In pre-myopic children, HAL lenses may offer a smaller benefit, particularly with high adherence, but the evidence is limited and of low quality, precluding a strong recommendation for routine myopia prevention. Given the modest number of studies, short follow-up, and substantial heterogeneity, all findings warrant cautious interpretation.
records.zhAbs: 现有证据提示HAL可减缓近视儿童眼轴与等效球镜进展；近视前儿童获益更小且证据有限、异质性大、随访短，解读需谨慎，尚不足以强烈推荐用于常规预防。

Given the modest number of studies, short follow-up, and substantial heterogeneity, all findings warrant cautious interpretation.

records.title: Assessing Near Vision in the Rapid Assessment of Avoidable Blindness Survey Methodology: Results of Validation and Feasibility Studies in India and Togo.
records.zh: 在RAAB调查中验证近视力检测可行，有助于评估人群老视矫正需求与近距离eREC证据。
records.authors: McCormick Ian, Rajendran Vinoth Kumar, Ayena Koffi Didier, Joseph Sanil, Oye Joseph, Bolster Nigel, Katibeh Marzieh, Resnikoff Serge, Ravilla Thulasiraj D, Bastawrous Andrew, Burton Matthew J, Ramke Jacqueline, Mactaggart Islay Z
records.journal: Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)
records.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Half a billion people worldwide have near vision impairment from unaddressed presbyopia. To address this, the 2021 World Health Assembly endorsed a global target for increasing effective refractive error coverage (eREC) for near vision. However, there is a global population data gap on near vision. This study tested the validity and feasibility of including a Peek Vision smartphone-based near vision screening test in the Rapid Assessment of Avoidable Blindness (RAAB) survey to allow more epidemiological data to be collected on this important global health issue.
METHODS: The study was done across four RAABs, two in India and two in Togo. In the first, the sensitivity and specificity of the Peek test was assessed to detect near vision impairment (cannot see N6 at 40 cm, binocularly) when compared to a printed near chart. Then, the feasibility was assessed with a review of teams' ability to still complete one cluster per day with the new content in the protocol. The RAAB Steering Group reviewed the findings to determine whether the new near vision content should be included in all RAABs.
RESULTS: The Peek near vision test had a sensitivity of 85.3% (95% CI: 80.3-89.4%) and a specificity of 88.2% (95% CI: 83.0-92.2%). This was considered sufficient to proceed with the feasibility assessment, and no implementation concerns were found in any survey. The RAAB Steering Group consultation recommended minor modifications to questions on spectacle ownership, and these questions were restricted to only those participants with a need for near vision correction.
CONCLUSION: The validity and feasibility of measuring near vision in RAAB surveys was confirmed. This new test will give eye care providers important information on the need for presbyopic correction in their population and start to build up the global evidence base for near eREC.
records.zhAbs: 印度与多哥可行性/效度研究确认：在可避免盲快速评估（RAAB）中加入近视力测量可行，可为老视矫正需求及全球近距离有效屈光矫正覆盖提供数据。
records.key: The validity and feasibility of measuring near vision in RAAB surveys was confirmed. This new test will give eye care providers important information on the need for presbyopic correction in their population and start to build up the global evidence base for near eREC.

records.title: Design and experimental evaluation of a rotationally symmetric zonal aspheric lens for early presbyopia correction.
records.zh: 提出旋转对称分区非球面镜（ZAL）作为早期老视矫正替代方案，对比传统渐进片以降低周边散光。
records.authors: Cui Yujie, Chen Xiaoqin, Fan Yanzhe, Hu Xiaoyang, Du Xinyu, Guo Xingyi, Zhang Kailang, Zhang Bingyin, Kang Yun, Liu Yongji
records.abstract: Progressive addition lenses (PALs) are inherently associated with peripheral astigmatism arising from their progressive optical architecture. We developed a rotationally symmetric zonal aspheric lens (ZAL) as an alternative approach for early presbyopia correction. The ZAL was designed using an eye model adapted to the participant's refractive prescription, fabricated, and experimentally characterized. Compared with a commercial PAL, the ZAL reproduced the intended power distribution and exhibited reduced peripheral astigmatism. A preliminary 14-day binocular wear evaluation was conducted in a single participant. Visual acuity and recognition accuracy were comparable between the ZALs and PALs, whereas median reaction time was longer with the ZALs (956.94 vs. 907.47 ms, p < 0.001). These findings demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed optical architecture and indicate that reduced peripheral astigmatism does not necessarily translate into faster functional visual responses under the present testing conditions.
records.zhAbs: 渐进多焦点镜固有周边散光；作者设计并试制ZAL，相对商品PAL能更好复现目标光度分布，反应时间等指标有差异，显示其作为早期老视光学替代的实验潜力。

records.title: Twelve-Month Efficacy and Visual Tolerability of MyoPi Spectacle Lenses in Childhood Myopia: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
records.zh: RCT：MyoPi连续自由曲面离焦框架镜12个月较单光镜减缓儿童眼轴与睫麻屈光进展，耐受可接受。
records.authors: Ye Lu, Liu Zhirong, Gao Hui, Ren Xiaobin, Wang Jiaqi, Bi Jiejing, Guo Yiming, Han Yijin
records.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the 12-month efficacy, safety, and visual tolerability of MyoPi continuous free-form defocus spectacle lenses compared with conventional single-vision spectacle lenses (SVLs) in children with myopia.
DESIGN: Prospective, multicenter, randomized, single-masked, parallel-group clinical trial.
PARTICIPANTS: A total of 116 eligible children were randomized 1:1 to MyoPi or SVLs. Eligible participants were 8 to 13 years of age with bilateral cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) from -0.75 to -5.00 diopters (D).
METHODS: Participants were randomized 1:1 to MyoPi or single-vision spectacle lenses and were followed at baseline, week 1, month 3, month 6, and month 12.
INTERVENTION: Children wore their assigned spectacles during routine daytime activities and were followed for 12 months.
MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: The primary efficacy outcome was change in axial length from baseline to month 12. The key refractive outcome was change in cycloplegic SER from baseline to month 12. Safety and visual-performance questionnaire findings were assessed as supportive clinical outcomes.
RESULTS: Of the 116 randomized children, 108 completed the 12-month follow-up. In adjusted bilateral mixed-effects models, model-estimated mean axial elongation (±standard error [SE]) was 0.19 ± 0.02 mm with MyoPi and 0.35 ± 0.02 mm with single-vision spectacles (between-group difference, -0.16 mm; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.20 to -0.12; P < 0.001). Model-estimated mean cycloplegic SER progression (±SE) was -0.37 ± 0.04 and -0.75 ± 0.04 D, respectively (between-group difference, 0.38 D; 95% CI, 0.27-0.49; P < 0.001). Adverse events occurred in 29.8% and 24.6% of participants, respectively; no serious adverse events, unexpected events, or device deficiencies were recorded.
CONCLUSIONS: In children with myopia, MyoPi continuous free-form defocus spectacle lenses slowed 12-month axial elongation and cycloplegic refractive progression compared with single-vision spectacles, with acceptable overall safety and visual tolerability.
FINANCIAL DISCLOSURES: Proprietary or commercial disclosure may be found in the Footnotes and Disclosures at the end of this article.
records.zhAbs: 随机临床试验显示，近视儿童配戴MyoPi连续自由曲面离焦框架镜，12个月眼轴增长与睫麻验光进展慢于单光镜，安全性与视觉耐受总体可接受。
records.key: In children with myopia, MyoPi continuous free-form defocus spectacle lenses slowed 12-month axial elongation and cycloplegic refractive progression compared with single-vision spectacles, with acceptable overall safety and visual tolerability.

records.title: Effects of Orthokeratology Versus Single-Vision Spectacles on Choroidal Structure and Microcirculation in Adolescents With Myopia.
records.zh: OK镜相对单光框架镜抑制青少年眼轴与屈光进展，并伴脉络膜厚度及三维CVI改变，或可作为疗效生物标志探索。
records.authors: Gong Qi, Yu Lurun, Yi Beixi, Xiong Xuewei, Duan Ouwen, Zhou Lianhong
records.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To compare the longitudinal effects of single-vision spectacles (SV) and orthokeratology (OK) lenses on choroidal structure and microcirculation in adolescents with myopia, and to analyze differences in responses between the two correction modalities.
METHODS: This prospective, nonrandomized cohort study enrolled myopic patients aged 8 to 15 years. Axial length (AL), spherical equivalent refraction (SE), choroidal thickness (ChT), and three-dimensional choroidal vascularity index (3D-CVI) in nine macular sectors within concentric rings of 1, 3, and 6 mm in diameter were measured at baseline and at 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, and 1 year after lens wear. Within-group and between-group differences were analyzed.
RESULTS: A total of 116 myopic patients aged 8 to 15 years were enrolled, including 62 in the SV group and 54 in the OK group. After 1 year, AL elongation in the OK group (0.101±0.032 mm) was significantly smaller than that in the SV group (0.393±0.035 mm; P<0.001), and the change in SE (-0.444±0.251 D) was also significantly smaller than that in the SV group (-0.863±0.372 D; P<0.001). Between-group differences in AL emerged from 1 month (P<0.001), and differences in SE emerged from 3 months (P<0.001). In the OK group, ChT increased across sectors during the first 1 to 3 months, followed by partial fluctuation and regression thereafter, whereas 3D-CVI generally increased during months 3 to 6 with mild later fluctuation. In the SV group, most sectors showed statistically significant differences, except for the outer inferior sector, but changes lacked a consistent trend; for 3D-CVI, significant differences were observed in several sectors, likewise without a consistent trend. Except at 1 week, increases in ChT and 3D-CVI in almost all macular sectors at subsequent time points were significantly greater in the OK group than in the SV group (most P<0.05).
CONCLUSIONS: Compared with SV, OK lenses suppress AL elongation and SE progression. There are increases in ChT and 3D-CVI associated with this suppression, suggesting that ChT and 3D-CVI may serve as biomarkers for evaluating the efficacy of myopia-control interventions and supporting further investigation of their role in mechanism of myopia control.
records.zhAbs: 与单光镜相比，OK抑制AL与SE进展，并伴ChT与3D-CVI升高，提示后者或可用于评估近视防控疗效及机制研究。

records.title: Efficacy and safety of cylindrical annular refractive element spectacle lenses for myopia in children: A meta-analysis.
records.zh: CARE柱面环形屈光元件框架镜Meta：相对单光镜评估儿童近视控制疗效与安全性。
records.authors: Almutawtah Sara, Ahmad Shahad T, Alasoosi Rashed A, Alhumaidi Abdulwahab, Almutairi Omar A, Alzoabi Abdullah, Alrashed Abdullah J, Alqussair Farah R, Mohammad Fahad, Alharran Abdullah M
records.abstract: BackgroundMyopia is an increasing global public health concern, particularly in East Asia. Cylindrical Annular Refractive Element (CARE) spectacle lenses aim to slow myopia progression by inducing peripheral myopic defocus. This meta-analysis evaluates the efficacy and safety of CARE lenses versus single-vision spectacle lenses in children.MethodsWe conducted a systematic search for randomized controlled trials comparing CARE spectacle lenses to single-vision lenses in children with myopia. Primary outcomes were mean change in spherical equivalent refraction and axial length. All analyses were performed using R software. Pooled mean differences and risk ratios with 95% confidence intervals were calculated using a random-effects model.ResultsAt 12 months, CARE lenses significantly reduced myopia progression compared to single-vision lenses. The treatment effect increased with longer follow-up, with one study reporting sustained benefit at 24 months. CARE lenses were associated with a significantly lower risk of fast progression. No significant differences were observed between groups in visual acuity change or discontinuation rates.ConclusionCARE spectacle lenses may be a well-tolerated, non-invasive option for slowing myopia progression in children, with modest benefits observed over one to two years. Larger, longer-term RCTs in diverse populations are needed to confirm these findings and establish sustained efficacy.

records.title: Modified Posterior Scleral Reinforcement with Comprehensive Therapy in High and Pathologic Myopia: A Prospective Cohort Study.
records.zh: 前瞻队列：改良后巩膜加固联合综合治疗对比常规光学矫正，用于高度/病理性近视进展控制。
records.authors: Liu Xiaowei, Yan Jing, Li Fang, Wang Hui, Cui Xiaoya, Li Xingru
records.abstract: This prospective cohort study aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of modified posterior scleral reinforcement (PSR) combined with comprehensive therapy versus conventional optical correction for controlling myopia progression in patients with high and pathologic myopia. A total of 203 patients aged 8-18 years were allocated, based on preference, to either the combination therapy group (n = 111; receiving modified PSR plus low-concentration atropine and/or peripheral defocus optical correction) or the conventional control group (n = 92; fitted with rigid gas-permeable contact lenses only). After accounting for 10 withdrawals during the study period, 193 patients completed the 24-month follow-up (combination group, n = 102; control group, n = 91) and were included in the final analysis. The primary outcomes were changes in axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent (SE). Secondary outcomes included best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA), posterior segment structural lesions, and adverse events. After 24 months, the combination therapy group showed significantly less AL elongation (0.33 ± 0.13 mm vs 0.70 ± 0.23 mm, p < 0.001) and SE progression (-0.75 ± 0.27 dioptres [D] vs -1.48 ± 0.57 D, p < 0.001) than the control group. The combination therapy group also demonstrated greater improvement in BCVA (p < 0.001) and lower rates of progression of myopic tractional maculopathy (2.9% vs 12.1%, p = 0.014) and aggravated tessellated fundus (6.9% vs 17.6%, p = 0.022) than the control group. The incidence of adverse events did not differ significantly between the groups (4.9% vs 4.4%, p = 1.000). In real-world clinical practice, personalized combination therapy centered on modified PSR is associated with slower axial elongation and refractive error progression and may help to stabilize posterior segment structures in patients with high and pathologic myopia, demonstrating more favorable clinical outcomes than conventional optical correction alone.

records.title: Atropine, red-light therapy, and lenslet spectacles for premyopia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
records.zh: 近视前儿童干预SR/MA：阿托品证据相对最多但确定性低；RLRL与特定微透镜框架镜或有获益，眼轴证据仍不确定。
records.authors: Martinez-Perez Clara, Piñero David P, Villa-Collar Cesar
records.journal: Graefe's archive for clinical and experimental ophthalmology = Albrecht von Graefes Archiv fur klinische und experimentelle Ophthalmologie
records.abstract:
PURPOSE: Earlier onset of childhood myopia is associated with greater subsequent progression and a higher risk of high myopia and related ocular complications. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated whether low-concentration atropine, repeated low-level red-light therapy (RLRL), and study-specific lenslet-array spectacle designs reduce refractive change and axial elongation in non-myopic children classified as premyopic.
METHODS: This review was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251252431) and conducted according to PRISMA 2020. PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus were searched from inception to 17 July 2026. Eligible studies were randomized controlled trials with follow-up ranging from 3 to 24 months that included children meeting study-specific criteria for premyopia and reported cycloplegic spherical equivalent (SE) and/or axial length (AL). Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane tool, and certainty of evidence was evaluated using GRADE. Mean differences (MDs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using RevMan 11.4.2.
RESULTS: Eight randomized controlled trials were included, seven conducted in China and one in India. At 12 months, 0.01% atropine was associated with a smaller myopic shift in SE (4 studies; 574 participants; MD, + 0.32 D; 95% CI, 0.12 to 0.52; I² = 72%; low-certainty evidence). RLRL also favored a smaller myopic shift (2 studies; 307 participants; MD, + 0.38 D; 95% CI, - 0.05 to 0.81; I² = 0%; very-low-certainty evidence). One study-specific positive Lenslet-Array-Integrated spectacle design involving 173 participants reported an MD of + 0.45 D (95% CI, 0.38 to 0.52). For AL, atropine showed a trend toward reduced axial elongation (MD, - 0.13 mm; 95% CI, - 0.26 to - 0.00; I² = 74%; very-low-certainty evidence), whereas RLRL showed an MD of - 0.16 mm (95% CI, - 0.30 to - 0.01; I² = 0%; very-low-certainty evidence). The lenslet-array study reported an MD of - 0.31 mm (95% CI, - 0.42 to - 0.20). Technical reporting and adverse-event assessment were incomplete, particularly for optical and red-light interventions.
CONCLUSION: Available randomized evidence suggests that some interventions may reduce early refractive change in children classified as premyopic, while effects on axial elongation remain less certain. Atropine had the largest evidence base, but certainty was low for SE and very low for AL. RLRL and the study-specific lenslet-array spectacle design showed potential benefits; however, limited replication, incomplete technical characterization, restricted geographic representation, and insufficient long-term safety evidence limit confidence and generalizability.

Atropine had the largest evidence base, but certainty was low for SE and very low for AL. RLRL and the study-specific lenslet-array spectacle design showed potential benefits; however, limited replication, incomplete technical characterization, restricted geographic representation, and insufficient long-term safety evidence limit confidence and generalizability.

records.title: Efficacy of Combined Highly Aspherical Lenslet Target (HALT) Spectacles and Low-Dose Atropine in Children with Poor Response to Atropine Monotherapy over 24 Months.
records.zh: 前瞻队列：阿托品单药反应不佳者联合HALT框架镜，观察12–24个月疗效。
records.authors: Sim Bryan Xiangrong, Kai-Lyn Loh, Chan Pauline Poh Lin, Sri Yudah, Chia Audrey
records.abstract: Objectives: To evaluate the 24-month efficacy of combining highly aspherical lenslet target (HALT) spectacle lenses with low-dose atropine (LDA) in children with poor response to atropine monotherapy. Methods: This prospective interventional cohort study included myopic children aged 6-11 years who continued to progress despite LDA (0.01-0.025%). Fifty children completed 12 months of follow-up and 48 completed 24 months. At 12 months, atropine dosage was maintained, reduced, or increased according to clinical discretion. Cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) were measured at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Results: Myopia progression during the first year (SER: -0.07 ± 0.45 D; AL: 0.13 ± 0.14 mm) was markedly lower than during the 6 months before treatment (SER: -0.61 ± 0.39 D; AL: 0.24 ± 0.12 mm). During the second year, atropine dosage was reduced in 23%, maintained in 67%, and increased in 10% of participants. Mean second-year progression was -0.26 ± 0.41 D and 0.17 ± 0.17 mm, with no significant differences between treatment groups. Although second-year SER progression exceeded first-year progression (p = 0.003), both SER and AL progression remained significantly lower than pre-treatment rates (p = 0.004). Over 24 months, 73.9% of eyes progressed ≤ 0.50 D and 71.7% progressed ≤ 0.40 mm. Younger age and greater first-year progression independently predicted greater 24-month SER and AL progression. Conclusions: Myopia progression was relatively well sustained over 24 months after combination treatment was started in children previously progressing on LDA. Younger children and those with greater early progression may warrant closer monitoring.
records.zhAbs: 6–11岁对低浓度阿托品仍进展的儿童，联合HALT框架镜随访至12个月50例、24个月48例，评估联合方案对持续进展者的控制效果。
records.key: Conclusions: Myopia progression was relatively well sustained over 24 months after combination treatment was started in children previously progressing on LDA. Younger children and those with greater early progression may warrant closer monitoring.

records.title: Comparative longitudinal evaluation of DIMS, progressive addition and single-vision lenses on myopia progression, binocular and visual performance in Spanish children.
records.zh: 西班牙儿童非随机比较：DIMS、低加光渐进（PAL）与单光镜对近视进展及双眼视/视觉功能的纵向评价。
records.authors: Solano-Molina Salvador, Carrillo-Pulido Miriam, Ortiz-Peregrina Sonia, Martino Francesco, Anera Rosario G, Jiménez José R
records.abstract: An 18-month prospective, non-randomized comparative observational study evaluated the effects of different optical corrections on myopia progression, binocular vision, and visual performance in Spanish children. Forty-five myopic participants aged 9-14 years were allocated to single-vision lenses (SV), low-addition progressive addition lenses (PALs), or defocus-incorporated multiple segments lenses (DIMS). Assessments included spherical equivalent (SE) and axial length (AL), comprehensive accommodative function evaluated by measuring amplitude of accommodation, positive and negative relative accommodation, accommodative facility, and accommodative response, and binocular function evaluated by measuring phorias, fusional vergences, and stereopsis. In addition, contrast sensitivity (CS), visual disturbance index (VDI), and subjective visual quality were assessed at baseline and at 6, 12, and 18 months. After 18 months, SE progression was -0.59 D for SV, -0.51 D for PALs, and -0.30 D for DIMS, corresponding to a 49% reduction with DIMS compared to SV. AL increased by 0.24, 0.27, and 0.23 millimeters, respectively, although inter-group differences were not significant for AL. Accommodative and binocular functions, visual acuity, CS, and VDI remained stable, while distance stereopsis improved in the DIMS group. These findings suggest an association between DIMS lens wear and reduced myopia progression compared with SV lenses in this cohort, without clinically relevant differences in accommodative or binocular function, visual acuity, or subjective visual quality.
records.zhAbs: 9–14岁45名近视儿童分入单光、低加光PAL或DIMS，随访约18个月，比较屈光/眼轴进展及双眼视与视觉表现。明确包含progressive addition lens作为近视干预臂。
records.key: Accommodative and binocular functions, visual acuity, CS, and VDI remained stable, while distance stereopsis improved in the DIMS group. These findings suggest an association between DIMS lens wear and reduced myopia progression compared with SV lenses in this cohort, without clinically relevant differences in accommodative or binocular function, visual acuity, or subjective visual quality.

records.title: Effects of myopia control interventions on myopia progression and strabismus-related outcomes in children with intermittent exotropia: a systematic review and meta-analysis protocol.
records.zh: 协议/综述注册：评估近视防控干预在间歇性外斜视儿童中对近视进展及斜视相关结局的影响。
records.authors: Yu Xin, Wang Yongrui, Chang Min, Wang Jingjing, Zhou Guohong
records.abstract:
ABSTRACT: 
INTRODUCTION: Intermittent exotropia frequently coexists with childhood myopia. Myopia-control interventions may affect accommodation, convergence or binocular function but evidence specific to children with intermittent exotropia has not been synthesised. This review will assess efficacy in randomised trials and comparative effectiveness and safety in non-randomised studies considering both myopia progression and strabismus-related outcomes.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This protocol follows the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis Protocols (PRISMA-P) 2015 statement. We will search PubMed, Embase (Elsevier), Web of Science Core Collection, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang Data and VIP Database together with ClinicalTrials.gov and the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry from inception to the final search date. The final searches are planned for May 2027. Eligible reports will include randomised trials and non-randomised comparative studies of participants aged 18 years or younger with intermittent exotropia and myopia. Interventions will include low-concentration atropine, orthokeratology, myopia-control spectacle lenses, repeated low-level red-light therapy and relevant combination regimens. Primary outcomes are changes in spherical equivalent refraction, axial length and distance and near angles of deviation. Two reviewers will independently select studies, extract data and assess risk of bias using RoB 2 for randomised trials and Risk Of Bias In Non-randomized Studies- of Interventions (ROBINS-I) for non-randomised studies. The Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach will be used to assess certainty of evidence. Meta-analysis will be restricted to studies with comparable intervention technologies, study designs, comparators, outcome definitions and follow-up periods; otherwise, findings will be synthesised narratively.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: Ethics approval is not required because only published and publicly available data will be used. Findings will be submitted to a peer-reviewed journal and presented at scientific meetings.
records.zhAbs: 拟系统综合RCT与非随机研究，同时关注近视进展与斜视相关安全性/双眼视结局；本文为综述设计说明，尚非最终效应量。
records.key: ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: Ethics approval is not required because only published and publicly available data will be used. Findings will be submitted to a peer-reviewed journal and presented at scientific meetings.

records.title: Cost-effectiveness of monotherapy and combination therapy for myopia control in Chinese children.
records.zh: 中国儿童近视控制成本效果：预算有限时户外与离焦框架镜较优；预算充足时可考虑RLRL或0.01%阿托品联合DIMS。
records.authors: Wang Jinghui, Li Xuan, He Meinan, Song Desheng, Zhang Bo, Du Bei, Wei Ruihua
records.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Myopia poses a major public health and economic burden in China, necessitating cost-effectiveness evaluations of control strategies. We aimed to assess cost-effectiveness of single/combined myopia control in children and adolescents to optimise strategies.
METHODS: We conducted a network meta-analysis to evaluate the efficacy of myopia control interventions in Chinese children (aged 6-18 years). Annual changes in axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent refraction (SER) were the primary outcomes. Additionally, we used a decision-analytic Markov model with clinical and cost data from China to evaluate 16 myopia control strategies for eight-year-old children over eight years from a patient perspective, with 3% discounting. Strategies included monotherapies and combined therapies. Main outcomes were incremental cost per unit reduction in myopic shift (i.e. SER) or AL elongation, compared with single-vision lenses (SVLs). Markov cohort analysis simulated the proportion of individuals progressing to high myopia under various strategies. We assessed robustness through deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses. We performed subgroup analyses by onset age (6, 10, and 12 years) and regional economic development.
RESULTS: For SER reduction, outdoor activity was cost-effective (incremental cost-effectiveness ratio = USD -18.29/dioptre (D)). At higher willingness-to-pay thresholds, 0.01% atropine combined with defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) (USD 660.74/D) and repeated low-level red-light therapy (RLRL) (USD 895.36/D) were cost-effective. For AL reduction, outdoor activity (USD -42.68/mm) and DIMS (USD 672.73/mm) were cost-effective at lower thresholds, while RLRL (USD 2011.32/mm) was preferred at higher thresholds. Compared with monotherapy, combination interventions improved preventive efficacy against high myopia. Subgroup analyses confirmed that the cost-effectiveness ranking was preserved across onset ages and regional economic settings.
CONCLUSIONS: Under limited budget conditions, outdoor activities and defocus spectacles represent advantageous cost-effective treatment options. When the budget is sufficient, RLRL may be considered a promising option pending confirmation of its long-term safety and effectiveness, and 0.01% atropine combined with DIMS is the preferred cost-effective option. Our analysis provides evidence-based guidance for clinicians and families in selecting effective myopia control strategies.
records.zhAbs: 模型分析提示：预算受限时户外活动与离焦框架镜更具成本效果；预算充足时RLRL待长期安全性确认后可考虑，0.01%阿托品联合DIMS为优选组合之一。
records.key: Under limited budget conditions, outdoor activities and defocus spectacles represent advantageous cost-effective treatment options. When the budget is sufficient, RLRL may be considered a promising option pending confirmation of its long-term safety and effectiveness, and 0.01% atropine combined with DIMS is the preferred cost-effective option. Our analysis provides evidence-based guidance for clinicians and families in selecting effective myopia control strategies.

records.title: Combination therapy for myopia control using defocus incorporated multiple segments spectacles in children refractory to higher-dose atropine.
records.zh: 对较高浓度阿托品反应不佳的儿童，联合DIMS框架镜有助于加强近视控制，仍需更大样本长期验证。
records.authors: Kuo Yu-Kai, Chuang Lan-Hsin, Chen Zi-Rong, Chen Hung-Chi, Wang Nan-Kai, Chen Ho-Min, Lai Chi-Chun, Hwang Yih-Shiou, Liu Chun-Fu
records.journal: Graefe's archive for clinical and experimental ophthalmology = Albrecht von Graefes Archiv fur klinische und experimentelle Ophthalmologie
records.abstract:
PURPOSE: To explore the efficacy of myopia control by adding defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacles in children who are refractory to higher-dose atropine control.
METHODS: This prospective cohort study included children aged 6-14 who had previously used ≥0.125% atropine for at least one year and were later treated with DIMS plus atropine for over six months. Annual axial length (AL) changes during monotherapy and combination therapy were compared using paired t-tests. Generalized estimating equations were used to analyze correlations with outcome variables.
RESULTS: In total, 57 eyes from 29 patients (mean age 9.8 years) were included in our final analysis. The mean AL value at the baseline was 24.6 mm. The mean follow-up duration was 27.9 months in the atropine-alone period and 18.2 months in the combination therapy period. Annual AL changes in the combination therapy period were significantly less than in the atropine-alone period (0.19 ± 0.18 mm/year vs. 0.29 ± 0.20 mm/year, P = 0.004). After adjusting for age, pupil size, and atropine concentration and compliance for DIMS together, both annual AL change and spherical power changes were associated with age negatively (P = 0.003 and P = 0.035, respectively).
CONCLUSIONS: Combination therapy of atropine and DIMS was effective in myopia control in children with poor response to atropine treatment alone. Further large-scale and long-term studies are needed to confirm these observations.
records.zhAbs: 观察显示阿托品联合DIMS对阿托品单药反应差的儿童有效；作者强调需大规模长期研究确认。
records.key: Combination therapy of atropine and DIMS was effective in myopia control in children with poor response to atropine treatment alone. Further large-scale and long-term studies are needed to confirm these observations.

records.title: The Visual Impact of Uncorrected Astigmatism in Eyes Fitted with Dual Focus Myopia Control Lenses.
records.zh: 未矫正散光对双焦点近视防控接触镜与单光接触镜的视力影响几乎相同。
records.authors: Meyer Dawn, Jaskulski Matt, Rickert Martin, Nguyen Myhanh, Chamberlain Paul, Bradley Arthur, Kollbaum Pete
records.journal: Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)
records.abstract:
PURPOSE: To quantify the impact of uncorrected astigmatism in myopic eyes fitted with dual focus (DF) myopia control contact lenses.
METHODS: The right eyes of 10 young adult myopes were corrected with standard single vision (SV, Proclear 1 day, CooperVision, Inc.) and DF (MiSight 1 day, CooperVision, Inc.) contact lenses. SV and DF contact lens powers were determined from SV over-refractions and any ocular astigmatism was corrected using cylindrical trial lenses. Visual acuity and subjective vision were measured through added cylindrical trial lenses (0.00DC, 0.75DC, 1.25DC, 1.75DC and 2.25DC) with spherical equivalent adjustments. With the 2.25D astigmatic lenses, spherical trial lenses were also used to focus the front edge, centre and back edge of the interval of Sturm. Data were analysed using linear mixed-effects regression models.
RESULTS: High illumination visual acuity was similar for both lens types (zero astigmatism model-estimated intercept: -0.25 logMAR for SV; -0.24 logMAR for DF), and visual acuity decreased linearly with increasing astigmatism, similarly with both SV (0.27 logMAR/D) and DF (0.23 logMAR/D) lenses. Under low room illumination and in the absence of astigmatism, SV acuity was slightly superior to DF (mean logMAR -0.03 and +0.06 for SV and DF, respectively) and the rate of visual acuity decline with increasing astigmatism was less for DF (0.21 logMAR/D) than for SV lenses (0.26 logMAR/D; p = 0.04). Subjective quality of vision ratings were higher for SV lenses compared to DF lenses (model-estimated intercept: 93 vs. 86). Quality of vision ratings decreased linearly with increasing astigmatism at nearly identical rates for both lens types (~19 rating units/D). LogMAR acuity and subjective ratings were similar when the edges or the centre of the interval of Sturm were focused.
CONCLUSION: Uncorrected astigmatism had an almost identical impact on visual acuity and vision quality in eyes fitted with DF myopia control and SV contact lenses.
records.zhAbs: 在配适双焦点近视防控接触镜与单光接触镜的眼中，未矫正散光对视力与视觉质量的影响几乎一致。
records.key: Uncorrected astigmatism had an almost identical impact on visual acuity and vision quality in eyes fitted with DF myopia control and SV contact lenses.

records.title: Real World Axial Elongation in Children Wearing Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization Spectacle Lenses: A Longitudinal Cohort Study with External Benchmarks.
records.zh: 真实世界队列：D.S.D.O.框架镜配戴儿童眼轴年增长约0.17 mm，低于部分历史外推期望，但属描述性关联非因果疗效。
records.authors: Wu Shuo, Chen Sitong, Wang Kai
records.abstract:
PURPOSE: To describe longitudinal axial elongation in children wearing spectacle lenses incorporating Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization (D.S.D.O.) technology in routine clinical practice and to place the observed change in context using two historical external benchmarks.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort included first time D.S.D.O. spectacle lens users with no documented prior myopia control lens wear and bilateral follow up of at least 12 months. Repeated axial length measurements from March 2022 through July 2026 underwent prespecified longitudinal quality control. The primary mixed effects model adjusted for age, sex, baseline axial length, baseline spherical equivalent, and any recorded atropine use. Sensitivity analyses addressed cycloplegic refraction, quality control exclusions, delay between lens initiation and baseline measurement, missing baseline refraction, and longitudinal covariance. External benchmarks used a Chinese pediatric normative model and age updated piecewise axial elongation rates from two Hong Kong single vision spectacle cohorts.
RESULTS: The cohort comprised 2396 children and 4792 eyes. Mean age was 9.23 ± 2.18 years and median follow up was 1.92 years. The primary adjusted axial elongation rate was 0.173 mm/year (95% CI, 0.171 to 0.174), with similar point estimates in cycloplegic, alternative quality control, baseline timing, missing refraction, random slope, and robust covariance analyses. Among 1665 children eligible for the Chinese model, observed change was 0.323 mm versus 0.625 mm expected, an absolute difference of 0.302 mm (95% CI, 0.290 to 0.314). Among 1515 children eligible for the Hong Kong benchmark, age updated expected change was 0.425 mm versus 0.319 mm observed, an absolute difference of 0.106 mm (95% CI, 0.096 to 0.117). Findings were similar after excluding children with any atropine record.
CONCLUSION: Axial elongation during D.S.D.O. spectacle lens wear averaged approximately 0.17 mm/year in this large routine care cohort. Observed changes were lower than both historical external expectations, but these benchmark contrasts are descriptive associations and should not be interpreted as causal efficacy estimates. Prospective studies with concurrent controls and standardized behavioral and treatment exposure data are required.
records.zhAbs: 常规医疗大样本中D.S.D.O.框架镜配戴期间眼轴年增长均值约0.17 mm，低于若干历史外部期望；作者明确不可据此推断因果疗效，需前瞻对照研究。

records.title: Multipoint Defocus Optics Technology Spectacle Lenses for Myopia Control in Children: A One-Year Interim Analysis of a Randomized Trial.
records.zh: 随机试验一年中期分析：多点离焦光学（PMDOT）框架镜在近视控制上非劣于HAL。
records.authors: Zhang Yurui, Han Xiaotong, Jin Ling, Ding Yi, Wang Decai, He Mingguang, Zeng YangFa
records.abstract:
PURPOSE: To evaluate the one-year efficacy of novel partition multipoint defocus optics technology (PMDOT) lenses in slowing myopia progression, compared to lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL).
METHODS: This is a 1-year interim analysis of an ongoing 2-year, non-inferiority randomized controlled trial, in which 194 children ages 8 to 13 years with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of -0.75 to -4.5 diopters (D) were randomized to either the PMDOT or HAL group. The primary outcome of the full trial was the mean between-group difference in SER change at 2 years, and the non-inferiority margin was -0.3 D. Secondary outcomes included changes in axial length (AL), choroidal thickness (ChT), and other biometric parameters, as well as best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) at 2 years and subjective visual experience. Data from right eyes were used for the current analysis.
RESULTS: The study included 102 children in the PMDOT group and 92 in the HAL group. After 1 year, the mean ± SD changes in SER and AL were not statistically significantly different between the two groups (PMDOT vs. HAL SER -0.74 ± 0.49 D vs. -0.60 ± 0.48 D, AL 0.26 ± 0.20 mm vs. 0.19 ± 0.19 mm) based on per-protocol (PP) analysis. The between-group difference in SER change at 12 months was -0.09 D (two-sided 97% confidence interval [CI], -0.26 to 0.09). Except for the change in anterior chamber depth in the PP analysis, no significant between-group differences were observed for any secondary outcomes.
CONCLUSIONS: PMDOT lenses were not inferior to HAL lenses in controlling myopia progression.
TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: This trial demonstrated the clinical potential of PMDOT lenses for myopia control in schoolchildren.
records.zhAbs: 儿童近视控制随机试验一年期中分析显示，PMDOT框架镜对近视进展的控制不劣于HAL框架镜。
records.key: PMDOT lenses were not inferior to HAL lenses in controlling myopia progression.

records.title: Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses versus 0.01% atropine for myopia control: Two-year randomised trial in children from Central Europe.
records.zh: 中欧儿童两年随机：DIMS框架镜在减缓近视进展上优于0.01%阿托品，尤以6–11岁为著，需考虑依从性差异。
records.authors: Wnękowicz-Augustyn Emilia, Wylęgała Edward, Kobielnik Martyna, Teper Sławomir
records.abstract:
PURPOSE: The global increase in childhood myopia underscores the need for effective control strategies. This study evaluated the effectiveness of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses versus 0.01% atropine eye drops in slowing myopia progression in European children over two years.
METHODS: A total of 110 Polish and Ukrainian children aged 6-16 years without significant ocular pathology were randomised to single-vision spectacles plus nightly 0.01% atropine (group A) or DIMS lenses plus nightly placebo (group B). Primary outcomes were changes in cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length, assessed at 6-month intervals.
RESULTS: At 24 months, mean axial elongation was lower in group B (0.22 ± 0.22 mm) than in group A (0.32 ± 0.29 mm), particularly among children aged 6-11 years (0.30 ± 0.23 mm vs 0.48 ± 0.31 mm). Similar patterns were observed for SER progression: 0.47 ± 0.47 D in group B versus 0.70 ± 0.58 D in group A, with the greatest difference in younger children (0.59 ± 0.48 D vs 1.05 ± 0.64 D). Differences in older children were smaller.
CONCLUSIONS: In this study, DIMS lenses were associated with greater efficacy than 0.01% atropine in reducing myopia progression, particularly in children aged 6-11 years. Differences in adherence between the interventions should be considered when interpreting these findings. DIMS lenses may represent an effective option for myopia control in European populations.
records.zhAbs: 两年随机试验中DIMS较0.01%阿托品更有效减缓近视进展，6–11岁更明显；解释结果时应考虑两组依从性差异，提示DIMS或可作为欧洲人群选项。

Differences in adherence between the interventions should be considered when interpreting these findings. DIMS lenses may represent an effective option for myopia control in European populations.

records.title: Multifocal electroretinography assessment of retinal responses to myopic defocus lenses.
records.zh: 短时mfERG：受试离焦分区镜设计未在正视眼引出可检出的一阶反应改变；方法学敏感但短暴露可能不足。
records.authors: Alhazmi Mohammed, Althomali Mohammed, Alanazi Muteb, Alotaibi Wafa, Alghamdi Eman, Almustanyir Ali, Alqahtani Fahd, Liu Maria
records.pending: 检索命中但题名/摘要与框架镜主题关联不明确，需人工确认
records.abstract:
AIM: To evaluate the short-term retinal electrical responses elicited by defocus segment lenses in emmetropic eyes using multifocal electroretinography (mfERG).
MATERIALS & METHODS: A prospective cross-sectional study enrolled 14 young, healthy emmetropic participants aged 18 to 22 years with no ocular or systemic diseases. Comprehensive eye examinations were conducted, and mfERG recordings were obtained using six different condition scenarios. Retinal responses were analyzed across hexagon ring groupings defined by angular extent (Ring 1: 2.5°, Ring 2: 7.5°, Ring 3: 14°, Ring 4: 22°, Ring 5: 30°). Statistical analysis was performed to compare retinal responses across different lens types and retinal regions.
RESULTS: No significant differences in retinal electrical responses were detected across the six lens conditions for negative (N1) latency (ms), positive (P1) latency (ms), or P1 amplitude (nV/deg2) (all p > 0.05). Regional variations in amplitude and latency across concentric retinal rings were observed but reflected expected normative mfERG gradients independent of lens type.
CONCLUSION: The tested defocus segment lens designs did not produce statistically detectable alterations in first order mfERG parameters in structurally intact emmetropic eyes under brief exposure. Although the analytical framework demonstrated sufficient sensitivity to identify medium to large electrophysiological effects, the current design may lack resolution for subtle retinal adaptations. Future investigations incorporating larger cohorts, prolonged optical exposure, and nonlinear analytical techniques in ametropic populations will be necessary to determine whether clinically relevant myopia control mechanisms correspond to measurable electrophysiological modulation.

records.title: Evaluating the effect of spectacle correction for refractive errors and presbyopia on cognitive function in rural older adults in China: protocol for a randomised, parallel-group, superiority trial.
records.zh: 中国农村老年RCT方案：评估为屈光不正与老视提供框架镜矫正是否减缓认知功能下降。
records.authors: Lv Liang, Yang Fan, Li Meng, Xiao Jun, Yang Houjiang, Li Dongfeng, Hu Chunmei, Wang Yiwen, Xiao Xiao, Jin Ling, Li Zhanrong, Zhou Lin, Wu Zhengzheng, Wang Huan, Wu Yuju, Zhou Huan, Congdon Nathan
records.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Vision impairment and mild cognitive impairment are highly prevalent in ageing rural populations of low- and middle-income countries. Observational studies suggest that vision correction may slow cognitive decline, but robust causal evidence-particularly from rural China-is lacking, despite an ongoing randomised controlled trial (RCT) in India. Our RCT will evaluate whether providing near and/or distance vision correction can slow cognitive decline among older adults in rural China, generating context-specific evidence to guide national policy and global healthy ageing strategies.
METHODS: This study is designed as an assessor-blind, parallel-group, individually RCT. A total of 964 participants (482 per arm) aged 60-79 years with correctable refractive error-related visual impairment at distance and/or near (presenting visual acuity <6/12 in the better-seeing eye, improving to ≥6/7.5 in either eye with spectacle and/or near visual acuity <6/12 at 40 cm when measured binocularly, improving to ≥6/7.5 in either eye with spectacle), rural household registration, normal hearing (defined as a hearing threshold <40 dB in at least one ear, assessed using the HearX HearTest) and Mini-Mental State Examination, Second Edition, Simplified Chinese version scores above education-specific cut-offs will be enrolled. After comprehensive eye examinations at township health centres or village clinics, intervention participants will receive distance, near or bifocal spectacles while controls will receive a prescription and spectacles at trial closeout. The primary outcome is the change in global cognitive function from baseline to the 36-month follow-up, assessed using the Chinese version of the Montreal Cognitive Assessment Basic, with and without adjustment for baseline score, age, gender, education and other potential confounders.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: The protocol is approved by the Institutional Review Board of West China School of Public Health and West China Fourth Hospital, Sichuan University, China (approval number: (HXSY-BEC-S2026005)). Results will be published in a peer-reviewed journal and presented at scientific meetings.

records.title: The Comparative Effectiveness of Four Myopia-Control Spectacle Lenses: A Real-World AIPW Cohort Study.
records.zh: 真实世界AIPW队列比较四种近视防控框架镜的相对效果（大样本电子病历）。
records.authors: Xiao Huan, Chai Yichun, Wen Juan, Mi Qiulin, Zhang Youruo, Duan Junguo
records.abstract: Purpose: We aimed to compare the real-world effectiveness of four myopia-control spectacle lens interventions for childhood myopia control using a doubly robust causal inference framework. Design: This was a retrospective cohort study with multi-treatment augmented inverse probability weighting. Participants: A total of 2764 myopic children (right eyes) aged 3-18 years were included, screened from 13,071 electronic medical records at Ineye Hospital, Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, between January 2023 and January 2026. Methods: Participants were allocated to four myopia-control spectacle lens groups and one single-vision spectacle lens group: Higher-Order Aberration Defocus (n = 912), Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (n = 800), Highly Aspherical Lenslets (n = 476), Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization (n = 238), and single-vision lenses (n = 338). A doubly robust estimator combining multinomial propensity-score weighting with outcome regression was applied to adjust for confounding. Outcome Measures: The primary outcomes were one-year changes in axial length and spherical equivalent. The secondary outcomes were the rates of rapid progression. Treatment-effect heterogeneity was explored across prespecified baseline age, refractive error, and axial length subgroups. Results: After adjustment, all four myopia-control designs significantly outperformed single-vision correction (p < 0.05). The design based on Higher-Order Aberration Defocus demonstrated the greatest efficacy, with an axial length change of 0.107 mm and a spherical equivalent change of -0.146 D. Within this group, 25.5% of children exhibited rapid axial elongation (≥0.36 mm/year) and 8.3% exhibited rapid myopic progression (≥-0.50 D/year). The treatment effect was statistically significant in children with low myopia or an axial length no greater than 26 mm (p < 0.05), but not in those with high myopia or pathological axial elongation. Conclusions: All four myopia-control spectacle lens designs demonstrated significant advantages over single-vision correction in real-world clinical practice. Particular emphasis should be placed on the role of myopia-control spectacles during the early stages of myopia. As myopia progresses to high myopia or pathological axial elongation, the efficacy of myopia-control spectacle lenses as a standalone intervention diminishes, and combined approaches incorporating multiple myopia management strategies may be warranted.

As myopia progresses to high myopia or pathological axial elongation, the efficacy of myopia-control spectacle lenses as a standalone intervention diminishes, and combined approaches incorporating multiple myopia management strategies may be warranted.

records.title: Adjunctive 0.05% Atropine for Children with Continued Rapid Myopia Progression During Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments Spectacle Lens Treatment: A Retrospective Matched Cohort Study.
records.zh: DIMS治疗中仍快速进展者加用0.05%阿托品，较继续DIMS单药眼轴与SER进展更慢。
records.authors: Xu QingLin, Xue Minsong, Liu Hong, Gao WenYu, Zhu Haiying, Ran Yuwen, Zhong Hong, Wen Longbo, Yang Zhikuan
records.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) lenses slow myopia progression, but some children continue to experience rapid axial elongation despite treatment. This study evaluated whether adjunctive 0.05% atropine was associated with additional myopia control in children with an insufficient response to DIMS monotherapy.
METHODS: This retrospective matched cohort study included 54 children with rapid myopia progression during initial DIMS lens wear. We matched 27 children receiving adjunctive 0.05% atropine with 27 children who continued DIMS monotherapy by age, sex, axial length, and spherical equivalent refraction (SER). A pre-intervention observation period of approximately 6 months was used to identify children with rapid axial elongation during initial DIMS monotherapy, followed by an approximately 12-month intervention period to compare progression outcomes between groups. Statistical analyses included t tests, chi-square tests, analysis of covariance, and multivariable linear regression.
RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups. During the pre-intervention phase, the time-normalized axial elongation rate was similar between the monotherapy and combination groups (0.47 ± 0.03 vs. 0.54 ± 0.03 mm/year, P = 0.170), whereas the combination group showed greater myopic SER progression than the monotherapy group (- 0.98 ± 0.10 vs. - 0.61 ± 0.11 D/year, P = 0.016). During the intervention phase, after adjustment for the corresponding pre-intervention progression rate, the adjusted axial elongation rate was lower in the combination group than in the monotherapy group (0.12 ± 0.04 vs. 0.31 ± 0.04 mm/year, P = 0.001), as was SER progression (- 0.19 ± 0.08 vs. - 0.55 ± 0.08 D/year, P = 0.001).
CONCLUSIONS: In children with rapid myopia progression during DIMS lens treatment, adjunctive 0.05% atropine was associated with a lower axial elongation rate and slower SER progression than continued DIMS monotherapy. These findings support further prospective evaluation of this treatment strategy.
records.zhAbs: 回顾性显示：DIMS下仍快速进展的儿童加用0.05%阿托品，眼轴增长与SER进展低于继续DIMS单药，值得前瞻验证。

These findings support further prospective evaluation of this treatment strategy.

records.title: Control effect of dual-mechanism myopia control lenses on myopia in children and adolescents: a prospective, 12-month, non-randomized, parallel-controlled, and single-center trial protocol.
records.zh: 双机制近视防控镜12个月非随机平行对照试验方案/注册，旨在为儿童青少年策略提供证据。
records.authors: Wang Ling, Zhang Qing, Zhou Shao-Qi, Huang Jun, Zhou Ting-Ting, Gu Yue-Si, Wang Wen-Xin
records.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Myopia has become an increasingly serious global issue. Preventing myopia and avoiding the risks of high myopia has become an important concern for children, adolescents and their parents. Dual-mechanism myopia control lenses (DMMCL) is a specialized design spectacle lens based on peripheral defocus theory and retinal contrast theory. Although the benefits of peripheral defocus lenses and retinal contrast-designed lenses (RCDL) in myopia prevention have been confirmed, whether the lenses integrating both two designs can effectively prevent further progression of myopia still requires further research.
PURPOSE: To report the protocol of a clinical trial designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of DMMCL vs. RCDL alone for slowing the progression of myopia among school-age children in China. The primary objective of this study is to evaluate whether DMMCL are equivalent to RCDL in controlling myopia progression.
METHOD AND ANALYSIS: This is a prospective, single-center, non-randomized, equivalence trial designed to compare the efficacy and safety of DMMCL vs. RCDL for controlling myopia progression in children aged 6-12 years over a 12-month period. The primary outcome is change in axial length (AL) from baseline to 12 months. We hypothesize that the two treatments are equivalent within a prespecified margin of ±0.15 mm. This study will enroll 120 myopic children, aged 6-12 years, with cycloplegic spherical equivalent (SE) ranging from -0.50 D to -6.00 D in both eyes. Eligible participants will be assigned to the DMMCL group (n = 60) or the RCDL group (n = 60) according to their own preferences, or those of their guardians. Participants will be advised to wear their assigned spectacles full-time throughout the trial. All participants will be advised to engage in at least 2 h outdoors per day and will be scheduled for regular follow-up visits. AL, cycloplegic SE, and binocular visual function will be assessed at baseline and throughout the 12-month study period. Both groups will complete questionnaires on adaptation and visual quality one week and one month after wearing the lenses. Participants from both groups will require a follow up visit every 3 months. The primary endpoint is the 12-month change from baseline in AL. Secondary outcomes include changes in cycloplegic SE and binocular vision. Adaption and vision quality questionnaire results are pre-specified outcomes.
OUTCOME: Primary outcomes: Twelve-month changes in AL Secondary outcomes: Twelve-month changes in SE from baseline and binocular visual function parameters. Other pre-specified outcomes Adaption and vision quality questionnaire results.
CONCLUSION: The future findings of this trial are expected to provide valuable reference for optimizing myopia management strategies and may contribute to the evidence base that informs pediatric eye care policy.Trial Registration: https://www.chictr.org.cn/, https://www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.html?proj=301629, identifier ChiCTR2600116438.

records.title: Progression with myopia control spectacles: identifying predictors of response to defocus incorporated multiple segment and highly aspherical lenslets spectacles in the French myopia cohort.
records.zh: DIMS与HAL配戴者出现三种进展轨迹，少数“持续进展者”仍有临床意义的进展。
records.authors: Najji Rime, Jonas Jost B, Bullimore Mark, Resnikoff Serge, Bron Alain M, Giraud Clément, Fernandez-Maloigne Christine, Bourne Rupert, Leveziel Nicolas
records.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To identify predictive factors of myopia progression in children wearing highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) spectacles.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: The 3-year longitudinal, retrospective real-world study included progressive children (≤ -0.5 dioptre (D)/year), aged 4-14 years collected from the French Myopia Cohort, between 2020 and 2025 who were prescribed myopia control spectacles (MCS). Myopia progression (spherical equivalent, D/year) was assessed at 12±3, 24±3 and 36±3 months after treatment initiation. A latent class growth model, adjusted for age, identified potential poor responders to MCS. Model performance was evaluated using Akaike information criterion, entropy and posterior class-membership probabilities. Logistic regression was then used to determine factors associated with persistent progression under MCS, including treatment group, renewal rate, baseline age, spherical equivalent, J0 and J45, sex and initial progression.
RESULTS: A total of 723 children (mean age 8.9 ± 2.4 years) were included, with no baseline differences between the DIMS and the HAL groups. Latent class growth modelling identified three distinct progression profiles: stable, moderate myopia progression and progressive myopia, with slopes of -0.05, -0.31 and -0.58 D/year, respectively. Fast initial progression strongly predicted progressive myopia class, while neither treatment type influenced class allocation. Progression risk under treatment was statistically independent of age, sex and baseline myopia.
CONCLUSIONS: Our study is limited as it examines only two types of myopia control treatments and lacks data on environmental factors. Myopic children treated with DIMS or HAL showed three distinct progression trajectories, with a small group of progressors continuing to progress at a clinically meaningful rate.

records.title: Oculomotor Profiles in Children Wearing Different Myopia Control Lenses: A Real-World Eye Tracking Study.
records.zh: 真实世界眼动追踪：比较OK、离焦框架镜与DOT镜儿童的眼球运动特征。
records.authors: Wu Shuo, Fu Hao, Li Wenjin, Li Hao, Wang Zehong, Wang Kai
records.abstract: To compare oculomotor profiles among children wearing orthokeratology, defocus spectacle, and diffusion optics technology lenses in a routine pediatric myopia management setting. This real-world observational study included children who had worn one of the three lens types for approximately one year and had available eye tracking data. Lens type was selected during routine clinical care rather than assigned by the investigators. Oculomotor parameters were compared among lens groups using Kruskal-Wallis tests with false discovery rate correction. One-year spherical equivalent change was examined only in the defocus spectacle and diffusion optics technology groups. Adjusted and exploratory analyses included age, sex, baseline spherical equivalent, baseline axial length, axial elongation, and parental education categories. A total of 134 children were analyzed, including 46 in the orthokeratology group, 49 in the defocus spectacle group, and 39 in the diffusion optics technology group. Significant group differences were observed for microsaccade frequency (FDR adjusted p = 0.00099), peak velocity (FDR adjusted p = 0.00099), latency (FDR adjusted p = 0.00395), fixation disparity (FDR adjusted p = 0.00395), and conjugacy (FDR adjusted p = 0.0274). Saccade frequency and saccade amplitude did not differ significantly. One-year spherical equivalent change did not differ significantly between the defocus spectacle group and the diffusion optics technology group (-0.27 ± 0.43 D vs. -0.34 ± 0.36 D, p = 0.312). No statistically significant correlation was observed between spherical equivalent change and microsaccade frequency in the two spectacle lens groups (Spearman r = -0.231, p = 0.069). Parental education categories showed no consistent association with oculomotor parameters after correction for multiple comparisons. Children wearing different myopia control lenses showed selective differences in oculomotor profiles. Refractive change in the two spectacle lens groups was similar, and the observed oculomotor differences should not be interpreted as direct indicators of myopia control efficacy. Eye tracking may provide complementary information about visual behavior and lens adaptation, but prospective studies with age-balanced designs and longitudinal refractive and axial length outcomes are needed.

records.title: Knowledge and Practices of South African Optometrists Regarding Childhood Myopia Management.
records.zh: 南非验光师儿童近视管理知识与实践横断面调查。
records.authors: Naipal Shivani, Rampersad Nishanee, Hansraj Rekha
records.abstract: Myopia is a growing public health problem expected to affect half the global population by 2050, making appropriate management of the condition necessary. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to investigate the knowledge and practices of South African optometrists regarding childhood myopia management. A quantitative, cross-sectional, descriptive design with a survey method was employed. An online questionnaire was distributed to practicing optometrists and included questions related to demographic information, knowledge of myopia and associated ocular pathologies, diagnostic work-up and management of childhood myopia. Data were summarised using descriptive statistics, and further analysed with univariate binary and ordinal logistic regression analysis where the independent variables were years of experience, certification and interest. A total of 124 completed questionnaires were received. The majority of participants used non-cycloplegic refraction and less than 20% performed dilated fundus examinations. Single vision distance spectacles were most commonly prescribed despite awareness of the efficacy of interventions to slow myopia progression. However, factors such as cost and the need for clinical guidelines limit the practice of evidence-based management. Participants were aware of some of the ocular pathologies associated with high myopia, indicating that this knowledge needs to be reinforced. Results from this study may be used to aid optometry policy development, regulatory council decisions and guide the content of professional development programmes to enhance knowledge.

records.title: The Prevalence of Spectacle Non-Adaptation Among Patients Presenting at a Private Practice in Witbank, South Africa.
records.zh: 南非私立诊所观察：框架镜不适应虽比例不高但有临床意义，主因多与处方与加工装配相关。
records.authors: Nukeri Bevily, Sukati Velibanti, Nkoana Pheagane Motsime William
records.journal: Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)
records.abstract:
PURPOSE: To determine the prevalence of and factors associated with spectacle non-adaptation in a private optometry practice in Witbank, South Africa.
METHODS: A retrospective descriptive study was conducted using clinical and dispensing records of patients prescribed spectacles between January 1 and December 31, 2024. Purposeful sampling identified patients who returned with complaints of non-adaptation to spectacles. Extracted data included demographic characteristics, spectacle type and factors associated with non-adaptation. Causes were categorised as being related to the prescription, dispensing, communication, binocular vision or pathology. Descriptive statistics summarised the data.
RESULTS: During the study period, 3146 spectacles were prescribed. Of those, 155 patients returned with complaints of spectacle non-adaptation. This yielded a prevalence of 4.9%. The mean age of the affected patients was 42.22 ± 17.13 years. Females accounted for 58% of cases. Non-adaptation was most frequently associated with multifocal spectacles (54%). Prescription and dispensing-related factors caused 44% and 28% of cases, respectively. Binocular vision and pathology-related factors accounted for smaller proportions of cases.
CONCLUSION: Spectacle non-adaptation, being observed in a small but clinically relevant proportion of patients, warrants serious attention in private practice settings. The predominance of prescription- and dispensing-related causes underscores the pressing need for rigorous accuracy and quality control throughout the optometric care process. Strengthening these areas is essential for reducing non-adaptation and ensuring continued use of spectacles.

records.title: Systemic Metabolic and Skeletal Muscle-Related Profiles Associated with Annual Axial Elongation Across Optical Myopia-Control Strategies in Adolescents: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
records.zh: 青少年光学近视防控策略下，代谢易感性与年眼轴增长轻度相关；临床意义与混杂仍不确定。
records.authors: Wang Xue, Wang Wenying, Han Fengmei, Li Ting, Kang Weiwei, Yang Xiaorui, Wang Jian, Yang Lidong
records.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Axial elongation varies among adolescents receiving myopia-control treatment, but the contribution of systemic metabolic and skeletal muscle-related characteristics remains uncertain. We examined these associations, treating recorded glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) status as a clinical marker rather than an independent drug exposure.
METHODS: This retrospective study included 3270 adolescents aged 7-18 years receiving single-vision spectacles, defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses, or orthokeratology. The primary outcome was annual axial elongation; composite treatment failure was exploratory. Multivariable regression, spline models, treatment-stratified analyses, and stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) were performed. Primary adjusted analyses included 2267 complete cases. The revised exploratory muscle-vulnerability score excluded GLP-1RA status and duration.
RESULTS: Among 3270 participants, 484 had recorded GLP-1RA use and showed greater obesity and insulin-resistance burden and less favorable muscle and activity profiles. In the comprehensive model, BMI z-score (β = 0.020 mm/year per unit; 95% CI 0.014-0.026) and HOMA-IR (β = 0.007 mm/year per unit; 95% CI 0.004-0.009) were associated with greater annual axial elongation. Skeletal muscle index was not independently associated, whereas handgrip strength showed a nonlinear association (P for nonlinearity = 0.002). Recorded GLP-1RA status was associated with 0.040 mm/year greater elongation (95% CI 0.031-0.049), without heterogeneity across myopia-control strategies (P for interaction = 0.646). After IPTW and comprehensive adjustment, the estimate attenuated to 0.032 mm/year (95% CI 0.021-0.043), with residual imbalance in four of 17 covariates. Associations with exploratory composite treatment failure were statistically uncertain in the comprehensive model (OR 1.23; 95% CI 0.93-1.63) and after IPTW (OR 1.17; 95% CI 0.80-1.70).
CONCLUSIONS: Metabolic vulnerability was associated with modestly greater annual axial elongation, although the clinical importance of the observed difference remains uncertain. Recorded GLP-1RA status identified a metabolically higher-risk subgroup but did not establish a drug effect. Muscle-related findings were not uniform, and residual confounding remained.

Recorded GLP-1RA status identified a metabolically higher-risk subgroup but did not establish a drug effect. Muscle-related findings were not uniform, and residual confounding remained.

records.title: Repeated low-intensity red light combined with defocus-incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacles for controlling myopia progression in children.
records.zh: RLRL联合DIMS框架镜12个月可增厚脉络膜、减缓眼轴与SER进展，短期安全性可接受。
records.authors: Cheng Wubo, Yi Xianglong
records.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the efficacy and safety of repeated low-intensity red light (RLRL) therapy combined with defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacles for controlling myopia progression in children.
METHODS: In this retrospective cohort study, medical records of 100 children with persistent myopia progression despite DIMS spectacle wear were reviewed. Patients were divided into two groups based on their treatment history: a DIMS-only control group (n=50) and an RLRL+DIMS combination group (n=50). Axial length (AL), spherical equivalent refraction (SER), uncorrected visual acuity (UCVA), central retinal thickness (CRT), subfoveal choroidal thickness (SFChT), corneal curvature (CC), fundus autofluorescence, adverse events were assessed at baseline and 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months.
RESULTS: Of the 100 enrolled children, 92 completed the 12-month follow-up. Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups (all P>0.05). At 12 months, the combination group showed significantly less axial elongation than the control group (mean change: 0.060±0.237 mm vs. 0.386±0.183 mm, P<0.001), with 37.8% of children showing axial shortening. SER progression was also significantly slower in the combination group (change: +0.038±0.435 D vs. -0.720±0.295 D; P<0.001). SFChT increased significantly in the combination group (+13.2±27.4 μm) but decreased in controls (-3.3±12.4 μm, P<0.001). No significant changes in CRT or CC were observed. Transient glare occurred in nine children; one child withdrew due to an 8-minute afterimage. No abnormal fundus autofluorescence was detected.
CONCLUSION: RLRL combined with DIMS spectacles effectively increased choroidal thickness, delayed axial elongation, and slowed SER progression in myopic children over 12 months, with a favorable short-term safety profile. Longer-term studies are warranted to confirm sustained efficacy and safety.
records.zhAbs: 联合重复低强度红光与DIMS框架镜在近视儿童12个月中增加脉络膜厚度、延缓眼轴与SER进展，短期安全；需更长随访确认。

records.title: Comparative efficacy of twice-daily 0.01% atropine combined with Orthokeratology versus DIMS lenses in myopia control: an elastic net penalized regression analysis.
records.zh: 回顾：每日两次0.01%阿托品联合OK较联合DIMS的眼轴增长更少；弹性网回归提示不同预测结构。
records.authors: Zheng Guoli, Xu Yi, Li Qingqing, Chen Fenghua, Liu Chang, Lou Xuefei, Wu Peimi, Wu Xuehui, Mao Jun, Wu Kunchao, Song Zongyan
records.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The increasing prevalence of childhood myopia necessitates effective intervention strategies. This study compared the 1-year efficacy of twice-daily 0.01% atropine combined with either Orthokeratology (OKA) or Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMSA) lenses in controlling axial length (AL) elongation, and utilized Elastic Net penalized regression to identify key predictive factors.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 220 myopic children (220 eyes), divided into the DIMSA group (n=120) and the OKA group (n=100). Axial length changes (ΔAL) over 12 months were evaluated. Multivariable linear regression and subgroup analyses were conducted to evaluate the independent associations. Additionally, propensity score methods and E-value sensitivity analyses were employed to address potential treatment-selection bias and unmeasured confounding. An Elastic Net regression model with 5-fold cross-validation was employed to handle multi-collinearity and perform feature selection for potential predictors of ΔAL.
RESULTS: The OKA group demonstrated significantly slower AL elongation than the DIMSA group (0.157 ± 0.154 mm vs. 0.313 ± 0.221 mm, P < 0.001). Multivariable regression indicated that the DIMSA regimen was associated with greater AL elongation compared with the OKA regimen (β= 0.144, P < 0.001). This association remained robust across all propensity score models, with high E-values (> 5.0) indicating strong resistance to unmeasured confounding. Subgroup analyses and interaction tests revealed a consistent association of OKA with less axial elongation across different age and myopia severity strata. Elastic Net regression identified shorter baseline AL and younger age as the primary predictors of faster progression. Notably, the Elastic Net models revealed distinct predictive architectures: the OKA group exhibited a parsimonious pattern primarily associated with age and baseline AL, whereas the DIMSA group displayed a "multi-driver" pattern associated with broader baseline covariates.
CONCLUSIONS: The combination of twice-daily 0.01% atropine with OKA was associated with less axial elongation in this retrospective cohort compared to the DIMSA regimen. Elastic Net regression suggested distinct predictive structures for each treatment, providing a basis for hypothesis generation.
